title: Cebu produces 205 topnotchers in September 2026 LEPT

blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — A total of 205 aspiring educators from Cebu landed in the Top 10 of the September 2026 Licensure Examination for Professional Teachers (LEPT), the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced Wednesday, November 25. Of the 205 topnotchers, 83 came from the elementary level and 122 from the secondary level. PRC said 29,602 elementary teachers out of 45,258 examinees passed. This brings the national passing rate to 65.41 percent. Meanwhile, 66,063 secondary teachers out of 86,953 examinees passed, bringing the national passing rate to 75.98 percent.
